dog.description_text:
3 month old
Lab mix
🐶 Playful, sweet, and full of personality!
🐾 Good with dogs and cats!
💕 Fully potty trained!
🏠 Kennel trained!
I LOVE to play, bark, and chase my furry friends! I get along with my foster mom's cats and dogs, and there's never a dull moment when I'm around! 🥰
And guess what? I'm FULLY POTTY TRAINED AND KENNEL TRAINED! That's right! I've been working hard on my puppy manners, and I'm ready to show my forever family what a good girl I am! ❤️
As much as I love playing, I also love being close to my people. Give me a cozy lap, lots of attention, and endless cuddles, and I'll be one happy little girl! 💕
🏡 All I'm missing is a family to call my own!
dog.name: Sara
